/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import re
from collections import Counter

with open('packet.json', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    packet = json.load(f)

expressions = {
    'document': 'd.number',
    'final_document': 'd.number',
    'disposition': 'ds.code',
    'wg_meeting': 'm.label',
    'cr_pack': 'p.pack_number',
    'tsg_meeting': 'p.tsg_meeting',
    'clause': 's.clause',
}

def literal(value):
    return \"'\" + value.replace(\"'\", \"''\") + \"'\"

meeting_joins = '''JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = ds.resolution_id
JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id'''
verified = \"ds.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND ds.scope = 'whole_target' AND m.wg = 'RAN4'\"
pack_joins = '''JOIN cr_in_pack AS cp ON cp.cr = ds.target
JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = cp.pack_id'''
rows = []
counts = Counter()

for item in packet['items']:
    q = item['question']
    fields = item['fields']
    select = 'SELECT DISTINCT ' + ', '.join(expressions[field] + ' AS ' + field for field in fields)
    prefix = ''
    if q.startswith('In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request '):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request (R4-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.-]+)\\) submitted\\? Give the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        assert fields == ['cr_pack', 'tsg_meeting'], item['id']
        body = f'''FROM cr_in_pack AS cp
JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = cp.pack_id
WHERE cp.cr = {literal('tdoc:' + match[1])}'''
        family = 'pack_lookup'
    elif q.startswith('RAN4 recorded document '):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'RAN4 recorded document (R4-\\d+) as revised\\. Follow its revisions to every later version that has a source-verified RAN4 disposition for the whole document and was submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\. Give each such document, that disposition, and the CR pack document number\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        assert fields == ['final_document', 'disposition', 'cr_pack'], item['id']
        source = literal('tdoc:' + match[1])
        prefix = f'''WITH RECURSIVE descendants(document_id) AS (
SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = {source}
UNION
SELECT rv.later FROM revision AS rv
JOIN descendants AS previous ON rv.earlier = previous.document_id
)'''
        body = f'''FROM descendants AS dv
JOIN document AS d ON d.id = dv.document_id
JOIN disposition AS ds ON ds.target = d.id
{meeting_joins}
{pack_joins}
WHERE {verified} AND d.id <> {source}'''
        family = 'revision_descendants'
    elif q.startswith('Trace change request '):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'Trace change request (R4-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.-]+)\\) from the RAN4 decision to the clauses it modifies\\. Give the source-verified disposition RAN4 recorded for the whole document, the RAN4 meeting, the TSG RAN CR pack document number, the TSG RAN meeting, and each clause of TS \\3 that the CR modifies\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        assert fields == ['disposition', 'wg_meeting', 'cr_pack', 'tsg_meeting', 'clause'], item['id']
        body = f'''FROM disposition AS ds
{meeting_joins}
{pack_joins}
JOIN cr_modifies_section AS cms ON cms.cr = ds.target
JOIN section AS s ON s.id = cms.section_id
WHERE ds.target = {literal('tdoc:' + match[1])}
AND {verified} AND s.spec = {literal(match[3])}'''
        family = 'trace_clauses'
    elif q.startswith('TSG RAN CR pack '):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'TSG RAN CR pack (RP-\\d+) carries change requests from RAN4\\. For each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN4 disposition for the whole document, give the document, the disposition, and the RAN4 meeting\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        assert fields == ['document', 'disposition', 'wg_meeting'], item['id']
        body = f'''FROM cr_pack AS p
JOIN pack_member AS pm ON pm.pack_id = p.id
JOIN document AS d ON d.id = pm.cr
JOIN disposition AS ds ON ds.target = d.id
{meeting_joins}
WHERE p.pack_number = {literal(match[1])}
AND d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR' AND {verified}'''
        family = 'pack_dispositions'
    elif q.startswith('Change request '):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'Change request (R4-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.-]+)\\) was handled by RAN4\\. What source-verified disposition did RAN4 record for the whole document and at which RAN4 meeting, and in which TSG RAN CR pack was it then submitted\\? Give the disposition, the RAN4 meeting, the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        assert fields == ['disposition', 'wg_meeting', 'cr_pack', 'tsg_meeting'], item['id']
        body = f'''FROM disposition AS ds
{meeting_joins}
{pack_joins}
WHERE ds.target = {literal('tdoc:' + match[1])} AND {verified}'''
        family = 'decision_and_pack'
    elif q.startswith('Which Rel-'):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'Which (Rel-\\d+) change requests that modify clause ([A-Za-z0-9.]+) of TS ([\\d.-]+) have a source-verified RAN4 disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\? Give each document, its disposition, the RAN4 meeting, and the CR pack document number\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        assert fields == ['document', 'disposition', 'wg_meeting', 'cr_pack'], item['id']
        body = f'''FROM section AS s
JOIN section_modified_by AS smb ON smb.section_id = s.id
JOIN document AS d ON d.id = smb.cr
JOIN disposition AS ds ON ds.target = d.id
{meeting_joins}
{pack_joins}
WHERE s.spec = {literal(match[3])} AND s.release = {literal(match[1])}
AND s.clause = {literal(match[2])} AND d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'
AND {verified}'''
        family = 'release_clause'
    else:
        raise ValueError('Unrecognized question: ' + item['id'])
    sql = ' '.join((prefix + ' ' + select + ' ' + body).split()) + ';'
    rows.append({'id': item['id'], 'sql': sql})
    counts[family] += 1

assert len(rows) == len(packet['items'])
with open('queries.jsonl', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for row in rows:
        f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + '\\n')
print('Lines written:', len(rows))
print('Family counts:', dict(counts))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import re
with open('packet.json', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    items = json.load(f)['items']
with open('queries.jsonl', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()
assert len(lines) == len(items), 'Line count mismatch'
for item, line in zip(items, lines):
    row = json.loads(line)
    assert set(row) == {'id', 'sql'}, 'Incorrect keys'
    assert row['id'] == item['id'], 'ID/order mismatch'
    sql = row['sql']
    assert isinstance(sql, str) and sql.startswith(('SELECT DISTINCT ', 'WITH RECURSIVE '))
    columns = sql.rsplit('SELECT DISTINCT ', 1)[1].split(' FROM ', 1)[0]
    assert re.findall(r'\\bAS ([a-z_]+)', columns) == item['fields'], 'Column/order mismatch'
    assert sql.count(';') == 1 and sql.endswith(';'), 'Unexpected statement boundary'
print(f'Lines written: {len(lines)}; check passed.')
PY"
